sn48.42:1.2: Atha kho Uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn48.42:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn48.42:2.1: Pañcimāni bho Gotama indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni na aññam aññassa gocaravisayam paccanubhonti ||
sn48.42:2.4: Imesaṃ nu kho bho Gotama pañcannam indriyānaṃ nānāvisayānaṃ nānāgocarānaṃ na aññamaññassa gocaravisayam paccanubhontānam kim patisaraṇam ko ca nesaṃ gocaravisayam paccanubhotī ti || || 4.
sn48.42:3.1: Pañcimāni brāhmaṇa indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti ||
sn48.42:3.4: Imesaṃ kho brāhmaṇa pañcannam indriyānam nānāvisayānaṃ nānāgocarānaṃ na aññamaññassa gocaravisayam paccanubhontānam mano paṭisaraṇam mano ca nesaṃ gocaravisayam paccanubhotī ti || || 5.
sn48.42:4.1: Manassa pana bho Gotama kim paṭisaraṇanti || ||
sn48.42:4.3: Satiyā pana bho Gotama kim paṭisaraṇanti || ||
sn48.42:4.4: Satiyā pana kho brāhmaṇa vimutti paṭisaraṇanti || || 7.
sn48.42:4.5: Vimuttiyā pana bho Gotama kim paṭisaraṇanti || ||
sn48.42:4.7: Nibbānassa pana bho Gotama kim paṭisaraṇanti || ||
sn48.42:4.8: Ajjhaparam brāhmaṇa pañhaṃ nāsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ ||
sn48.42:4.9: nibbānogadam hi brāhmaṇa brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyanaṃ nibbānapariyosānanti || || 9.
sn48.42:5.1: Atha kho Uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 10.
sn48.42:6.1: Atha kho Bhagavā acirapakkante Uṇṇābhe brāhmaṇe bhikkhū āmantesi || || 11.
sn48.42:6.2: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave kuṭāgāre vā kuṭāgārasālāyaṃ vā pācīnavātapānā suriye uggacchante vātapānena rasmiyo pavisitvā kāya patiṭṭhitā ti || ||
sn48.42:6.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave Uṇṇābhassa brāhmaṇassa Tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā daḷhā asaṃhāriyā sāmaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ || ||
sn48.42:6.5: Imamhi ce bhikkhave samaye Uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo kālaṃ kareyya natthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto Uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo puna imaṃ lokam āgaccheyyāti || || 1.
